title: Connector marketplace: mini playbook — SKU acceptance & copy snippets
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact, action-focused playbook for integrating and publishing partner connectors and SKU listings in cloud marketplaces (AWS/Azure/GCP). It pairs acceptance heuristics (what we require to go live) with short, A/B-friendly copy snippets that partners can iterate on. Keep this doc as the rapid preflight for early partner integrations — not the full legal/contract spec.

Scope and audience:
- Audience: partnerships, partner engineering, partner marketing, listing ops, and PMs.
- Scope: connector-type SKUs (cloud connectors, data-source adapters, managed integrations). Not for core platform product tiles.

Quick rules (digest):
- Minimal viable listing: tile + short desc + 2 bullets + one screenshot (or animated GIF) + entitlement & trial terms.
- All copy must pass compliance review if it references security, PHI, or SOC2.
- Data residency / KMS requirements must be stated in the tile metadata for private deployments.

Acceptance heuristics (go/no-go):
1) Functional: connector accepts auth, establishes stable session, and can perform a canonical read/write flow under 95th pct latency budget for demo dataset.
2) Security: partner supports token rotation or OAuth; documentation on least-privilege IAM roles provided.
3) Billing/entitlement: SKU maps to internal billing SKU id and trial entitlement flow tested (trial provisioning succeeds end-to-end).
4) UX: tile assets (logo 120x120 SVG, 1 hero screenshot 1200x675) and one short demo GIF <= 6s provided.
5) Legal/compliance: privacy/data processing statement drafted and approved by legal if connector touches PII/PHI.
6) Observability: telemetry events instrumented (connect, success, error) and test traces accessible to Redwood SRE.

Required metadata fields (minimal):
- partner_name (string)
- sku_id (internal)
- tile_title (max 50 chars)
- short_description (max 140 chars)
- long_description (max 600 chars)
- category (connectors / data-source / analytics)
- pricing_model (metered | subscription | free-trial)
- trial_length_days (int)
- data_residency (regions list or "global")
- kpi_samples (up to 3 example metrics to display on tile)

Copy snippets (A/B variants) — use these as starting points for marketplace tile copy. Keep the short desc punchy, long desc explanatory and benefits-led.
- Tile title (option A): "S3-to-Redwood Connector — Nearline Sync & Search"
- Tile title (option B): "S3 Connect: Secure indexing and streaming sync"

- Short description (A): "Index & query S3 data with a managed connector. Low-latency sync, schema-aware parsing, pay-as-you-go."
- Short description (B): "Connect S3 buckets to Redwood for instant search and embeddings — no infra to manage."

- Long description (example): "Quickly onboard S3 data into Redwood Inference: schema-aware ingestion, incremental syncs, and optional encryption-at-rest with customer-managed keys. Use this connector for search, embeddings, and analytics workflows. Includes instrumentation for usage and health, plus a 14-day trial with automatic billing on conversion."

- 3 bullets to appear under tile (short):
  • Nearline incremental syncs (delta-only)
  • Customer-managed KMS support
  • Simple IAM role template + one-click demo

Microcopy variations for CTA button:
- Try free for 14 days
- Add to account (trial)
- Request a hosted demo

Preflight QA checklist (manual + automated):
- [ ] Smoke test: connector can fetch a 10MB sample in under 8s in target region (run harness: ./scripts/smoke-s3.sh)
- [ ] Auth test: rotate token and confirm reconnect behavior within 30s
- [ ] Billing: create trial order and confirm billing event JIRA-4578 fires with SKU mapping
- [ ] Visual assets: logos, screenshots verified on staging tile at 1x and 2x DPR
- [ ] Copy legibility: short desc <=140 chars; long desc <=600; no trademark claims
- [ ] Telemetry: health pings observed in demo workspace for 48h

Localization notes:
- Provide short desc translated to EN/FR/DE/JA for public listings — ops will stage EN-only for early launches. Use neutral pluralization (avoid gendered phrasing).

Edge cases & risk flags (things that delay publish):
- Connector requires onboarding access to customer PII by default — escalate to security/legal.
- Connector performs in-region compute and needs additional marketplace listing compliance (e.g., GCP Healthcare).
- If partner includes a bundled managed service, ensure SLA and support contact fields are present in metadata.

Technical gating (engineering):
- API contract: provide OpenAPI snippet for the canonical call flow (auth -> list -> fetch) and a sample response for the demo dataset.
- Backwards compatibility: if connector versioning is present, must support v1/v2 migration or clear deprecation notes.
- Helm / deployment: if partner manages an appliance, provide a minimal helm chart or VM image manifest and EULA link.

Ops & rollout plan (recommended):
1) Partner sandbox onboarding (2–3 days): connect demo data, validate smoke tests.
2) Staging tile verification (1–2 days): assets + copy + trial provisioning.
3) Beta publish (2 weeks): small set of customers, monitor cost/latency impact.
4) GA (after 2 weeks stable): full marketplace publish, email announce + partner blog post.

Owner responsibilities (who does what):
- Partner engineering: provide API contract, demo dataset, deployment artifacts.
- Partner marketing: provide hero screenshot, GIF, 2 copy variants, and localization.
- Redwood listing ops: attach SKU to internal billing, validate trial flow, push to staging.
- Redwood security: approve the privacy statement + IAM template.

Quick timeline template (editable):
- Kickoff -> Day 0
- Sandbox validation -> Day 1–3
- Staging tile -> Day 4–6
- Beta cohort -> Day 7–21
- GA decision -> Day 21+

Open questions / TODOs:
- [ ] Confirm whether AWS Marketplace requires an additional vendor account cert for this connector (ask legal).
- [ ] Decide default trial length (14 vs 30 days) for connectors that touch PII.
- [ ] Create a small metrics dashboard template for partner adoption tracking (owner: SRE).

Notes to self (working):
- Keep copy tight; ops prefers shorter titles. If partner insists on long brand + product name, include brand in long_desc but shorten tile_title.
- For quick beta, accept jpeg hero but require SVG for GA.

Example file naming for partner artifacts (for inbox + staging):
- partnername-sku123-assets.zip
- partnername-sku123-iam-template.yaml
- partnername-sku123-demo-data.jsonl

Contact & escalation list:
- Partnerships (primary): aisha@redwood.ai
- Listing ops: marcus@redwood.ai
- Security reviewer: sofia@redwood.ai

Appendix: sample IAM least-privilege notes (short):
- Provide an IAM role that grants ListBucket, GetObject for target buckets only. Avoid full S3:* on partner-managed roles.

End of mini-playbook.

---
Working draft: leave comments inline and add to linked artifacts. This doc is intentionally compact — hand off to the onboarding spreadsheet once the partner reaches sandbox validation.
